question: A 12-year-old African American is exposed to pollen while playing outside. The allergen stimulates TH2 cells of his immune system to secrete a factor that leads to B-cell class switching to IgE. What factor is secreted by the TH2 cell?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: TH2 cell activation -> secretion of IL-4 -> B-cell class switching to IgE -> 95%
analysis: In this scenario, the TH2 cells are stimulated by the allergen to secrete IL-4, which plays a crucial role in B-cell class switching to IgE. This process is a key component of the allergic response.
